2026-09-17  Introducing the Life Sciences Verification Program  *** REPORTED 2026-09-22 ***
            Vetted-access entitlement. Standard Use = Mythos/Opus/Sonnet with bio classifiers tuned
            permissive for science tasks. High-risk Use add-on = REMOVES ALL safeguards that block
            life sciences requests, for a named project. Cyber classifiers and other safeguards retained.
            Annual (Standard) / bi-annual (High-risk) grants scoped to declared use cases. Enforcement
            shifts from real-time blocking to OFFLINE pattern analysis.
            2nd instance of guardrail-by-entitlement after Mythos 5.
